decided_by: PI ruling following the SDS_G1_4 confirmation
supersedes: the eligibility criterion of STRATEGIC_DEMAND_SEARCHER_FROZEN / _V2_FROZEN, prospectively only

why_the_search_problem_changed.settled: TWO_WAY_PAYOFF_REVERSAL = CONFIRMED on untouched seeds. The searcher no longer has to discover whether payoff crossover is possible in this environment; it is.
why_the_search_problem_changed.remaining: strategic uncertainty -- whether BLUE must commit before it can tell which world it is in
why_the_search_problem_changed.restatement: the search problem is now 'find a late-revealing version of the strategic pressure we already know exists', which is far narrower than the earlier 'find strategies somehow'

primary_constraint.preserve_GUARD_payoff_pressure: delta_G(A') > 0 required at every stage. A candidate that raises concealment by destroying the payoff reversal is not a candidate.
primary_constraint.rationale: the reversal is the confirmed asset. It is a constraint, not a term to be traded away.

eligibility_replaces_precommitment_uncer.old_V1_status: RETIRED. It selected SDS_G1_4 on +16.625 in development, which became -17.406 on confirmation. That is exactly the instability the search stage exists to prevent.
eligibility_replaces_precommitment_uncer.new_V2: development_eligible requires delta_G > PROMOTE_DELTA_G AND p_C point estimate above a development threshold AND J > 0
eligibility_replaces_precommitment_uncer.note: the development p_C threshold is a search screen, not the confirmation gate. The confirmation gate remains LCB95(p_C) > 0.5 on a fresh untouched block.

where_the_concealment_problem_actually_i.evidence: intent observation rate 0.938 against SDS_G1_4 versus 0.344 against OP7; p_C 0.656 versus 0.875
where_the_concealment_problem_actually_i.reading: OP7 already conceals its intent well. SDS_G1_4 telegraphs: its overlay produces RED behaviour that is readable in 94% of episodes.
where_the_concealment_problem_actually_i.consequence: the search should work on the A pole. OP7 is not the problem and is not to be modified -- it is a canonical registry entry and the confirmed B pole.
where_the_concealment_problem_actually_i.gene_groups_most_relevant: the concealment group already declared in STRATEGIC_DEMAND_SEARCHER_V2_FROZEN (opening_hold_steps, lane_amplitude_frac, enable_defender), now promoted from a weakness-pressure hint to the primary search direction

degeneracy_pressure_increased.observed: frac_0_0 = 0.625 on the A pole and 0.719 on the B pole in the confirmation
degeneracy_pressure_increased.status: NOT retroactively a Gate B failure -- it was not preregistered as one and is not being converted into one after the fact
degeneracy_pressure_increased.prospective: continue penalising aggressively. The next opponent must preserve the crossover while producing more actual game interaction.
degeneracy_pressure_increased.why_it_matters_later: a benchmark dominated by 0-0 trajectories gives a learner a very thin reward signal, which will bite when PPO is re-enabled

explicitly_unchanged: GUARD = BLUE_ONE_DEFENDER_V2 and BREACH = BLUE_BOTH_ATTACK_V2 -- do not change
OP7 as the canonical B pole -- never overwritten
canonical registry OP6-OP12 -- never overwritten; candidates remain overlays
the 0.15 payoff floor and LCB95 > 0 requirement
2v2 only -- no experiment below 2v2; isolate mechanisms through telemetry, never by deleting agents
evolution alters only legal 2v2 opponent behaviour
prohibited: training PPO, specialists, a selector, or a latent policy -- V3_STRATEGIC_DEMAND is NOT VALIDATED
running another evolutionary search under the retired OBSERVABILITY_V1 eligibility criterion
re-using spent confirmation blocks 5000001 (spent) or the permanently disqualified 2500001 / 2600001
trading away delta_G to gain p_C
re-scoring the SDS_G1_4 confirmation under V2 and calling it a pass
sequence: 1. ratify the observability confirmation episode count (see OBSERVABILITY_V2_FROZEN.episode_count_OPEN_REQUIRES_RATIFICATION; recommendation n=64)
2. wire OBSERVABILITY_V2 into the searcher's per-candidate evaluation, replacing the V1 gap gate
3. run the retargeted search: preserve delta_G > 0, maximise p_C, reduce frac_0_0
4. freeze any development-eligible candidate BEFORE confirmation, as was done for SDS_G1_4
5. audit a fresh seed block with scripts/audit_seed_block.py over its FULL range including git history
6. confirm on that untouched block: payoff reversal AND LCB95(p_C) > 0.5
